description: The plot illustrates the relationship between "Ratio" and "minFDE$_{20}$ ($\downarrow$)" for five different configurations. The x-axis, labeled "Ratio", uses a linear scale ranging from 0.1 to 1.0, with numeric tick marks spaced at intervals of 0.2. The y-axis, labeled "minFDE$_{20}$ ($\downarrow$)", also employs a linear scale with a visible data range from approximately 0.75 to 1.35, featuring tick marks at intervals of 0.1. All five configurations are represented by solid lines with circular markers. The blue line, labeled "TrajICL", starts at a value of approximately 0.90 at x=0.1, remains relatively steady across the x-axis with a slight dip to 0.86 at x=0.3, and ends at approximately 0.85 at x=1.0. The orange line, labeled "Head Tuning", begins at the highest point on the plot at approximately 1.32 at x=0.1, declines steadily to about 1.06 at x=0.9, and ends slightly higher at 1.07 at x=1.0. The green line, which corresponds to a solid grey rectangular block in the legend rather than text, starts at approximately 1.09 at x=0.1 and exhibits a continuous decline across the entire range, ending at the lowest point on the graph at approximately 0.76 at x=1.0. The red line, labeled "LoRA 16", starts at approximately 1.22 at x=0.1, declines to 0.94 at x=0.7, remains flat until x=0.9, and ends at 0.93 at x=1.0. Finally, the purple line, labeled "LoRA 64", begins at approximately 1.22 at x=0.1, closely tracking the red line initially, and declines steadily to end at approximately 0.93 at x=1.0.
